instructions.title: Your motion to reinstate: before you file (do not file this page)
lines: This file has the Verified Motion to Reinstate Petition for an Order for Protection (PO-0111) with your answers printed on it.
This motion is for a petition the court dismissed when it was not your fault (Trial Rule 41(F)). If you dismissed it yourself, you can file a new petition instead.
Sign and date it by hand. You sign under penalty of perjury.
Print 3 copies, unless the clerk tells you otherwise: one for the court, one for the other person, and one for you.
File it with the clerk of the court that dismissed your petition.
This page is not part of your filing. Remove it before you file.

fields.label: Why was your petition dismissed?
